given: an organization with a Crew member, a second Crew member, a Supervisor, a Supply Officer and an Administrator
two active vehicles and one inactive vehicle
the default maximum assignment length of 24 hours
when: each role assigns itself to a vehicle, moves itself to the other, extends and ends its own assignment
a Crew member on one vehicle extends and ends a partner's assignment there, moves a person over from the other vehicle, and adds an unassigned person
a Crew member tries to extend or end an assignment on a vehicle they are not on, and posts the change directly
a person is assigned to a second vehicle
assignments are attempted with no end time, an end time in the past, one beyond the maximum, and on the inactive vehicle
an assignment reaches its end time with no further action
an unassigned person and a person assigned elsewhere open an inspection and record checks on a vehicle
the current-crew projection is rebuilt from the event history
the assigned person opens Home within 30 minutes of the end time, and a vehicle notice is sent to the current crew
then: every role can assign, move, extend and end its own assignment
the Crew member on the vehicle can correct its crew, including the move, and the people changed and the crew they left are notified
changes on a vehicle the actor is not on are refused server-side and nothing changes; only a Supervisor or Administrator can change any assignment
the second assignment ends the first in the same event, a vehicle accepts any number of people, and the inactive vehicle is refused
the missing, past and too-late end times are refused
the assignment stops applying at its end time with no event, and nothing renews it
both people can inspect and record checks on any vehicle, and conditional-obligation determinations are the same with or without assignments
the rebuilt projection matches the live read
Home lists the person's current vehicle first and offers Extend; each crew member receives the vehicle notice once
when adding people, someone already on another vehicle is listed with that vehicle and end time, never hidden
notes: Language-neutral contract for owner-approved SPEC amendment 4.4.0 (issue #202). The scenario is not yet bound to application commands.
